Plotting (ds.pl)#

Visualization functions for GRN analysis, perturbation results, and model diagnostics.

Utilities#

deepscenic.pl.set_colors(mdata, key, colors=None, cmap='tab20')[source]#

Set colors for a categorical variable in mdata.uns.

Parameters:

  • mdata (MuData) – MuData object.

  • key (str) – Key in mdata.obs to color.

  • colors (list[str] | dict[str, str] | None) – Colors to use. If None, generate from cmap. Can be list (ordered) or dict (category -> color).

  • cmap (str) – Colormap to use if colors is None.

Raises:

  • KeyError – If key not found in mdata.obs or any modality’s obs.

  • ValueError – If number of colors doesn’t match number of categories.

Return type:

None

deepscenic.pl.get_colors(mdata, key, cmap='tab20')[source]#

Get colors for a categorical variable.

Parameters:

  • mdata (MuData) – MuData object.

  • key (str) – Key in mdata.obs.

  • cmap (str) – Colormap to use if colors not stored.

Returns:

Mapping from category to color.

Return type:

dict[str, str]

Raises:

KeyError – If key not found in mdata.obs or any modality’s obs.

deepscenic.pl.setup_axes(ax=None, figsize=None)[source]#

Get or create axes for plotting.

Parameters:

  • ax (Axes | None) – Pre-existing axes. If None, create new figure.

  • figsize (tuple[float, float] | None) – Figure size if creating new figure.

Returns:

Figure and axes objects.

Return type:

tuple[Figure, Axes]

deepscenic.pl.savefig_or_show(writekey, show=None, save=None, ext='pdf', dpi=150)[source]#

Scanpy-compatible save/show handler.

Parameters:

  • writekey (str) – Base filename (e.g., ‘heatmap_grn’).

  • show (bool | None) – Display figure. If None, show if not saving.

  • save (str | bool | None) – Save figure. True for default name, str for suffix.

  • ext (str) – File extension.

  • dpi (int) – Resolution for saved figure.

Return type:

None

GRN Visualization#

Heatmaps#

deepscenic.pl.heatmap_e1(model, *, tfs=None, regions=None, top_k=50, ax=None, cmap='viridis', show=None, save=None, return_fig=False, figsize=(10, 8), **kwargs)[source]#

Plot E1 (TF->region) heatmap.

Parameters:

  • model (DeepSCENICModel) – Trained DeepSCENICModel.

  • tfs (list[str] | None) – TFs to include. If None, use top by variance.

  • regions (list[str] | None) – Regions to include. If None, use top by variance.

  • top_k (int | None) – Number of top TFs/regions to show if not specified.

  • ax (Axes | None) – Pre-existing axes.

  • cmap (str) – Colormap.

  • show (bool | None) – Display figure.

  • save (str | bool | None) – Save figure.

  • return_fig (bool) – Return Figure instead of Axes.

  • figsize (tuple[float, float]) – Figure size.

  • **kwargs – Passed to seaborn.heatmap.

Return type:

Axes, Figure, or None

deepscenic.pl.heatmap_e2(model, *, genes=None, top_k=50, ax=None, cmap='viridis', show=None, save=None, return_fig=False, figsize=(10, 8), **kwargs)[source]#

Plot E2 (region->gene) heatmap.

Parameters:

  • model (DeepSCENICModel) – Trained DeepSCENICModel.

  • genes (list[str] | None) – Genes to include.

  • top_k (int | None) – Number of top genes/regions to show.

  • ax (Axes | None) – Pre-existing axes.

  • cmap (str) – Colormap.

  • show (bool | None) – Display figure.

  • save (str | bool | None) – Save figure.

  • return_fig (bool) – Return Figure instead of Axes.

  • figsize (tuple[float, float]) – Figure size.

  • **kwargs – Passed to seaborn.heatmap.

Return type:

Axes, Figure, or None

Networks#

deepscenic.pl.network_grn(model, *, tfs=None, genes=None, top_k=20, threshold=0.1, layout='spring', node_size_tf=800, node_size_gene=300, tf_color='#E64B35', gene_color='#4DBBD5', edge_cmap='Greys', ax=None, show=None, save=None, return_fig=False, figsize=(12, 12), **kwargs)[source]#

Plot GRN as a network graph.

Parameters:

  • model (DeepSCENICModel) – Trained DeepSCENICModel.

  • tfs (list[str] | None) – TFs to include.

  • genes (list[str] | None) – Target genes to include.

  • top_k (int) – Number of top edges to show per TF.

  • threshold (float) – Minimum edge weight to include.

  • layout (str) – Network layout: ‘spring’, ‘circular’, ‘kamada_kawai’.

  • node_size_tf (int) – Size of TF nodes.

  • node_size_gene (int) – Size of gene nodes.

  • tf_color (str) – Color for TF nodes.

  • gene_color (str) – Color for gene nodes.

  • edge_cmap (str) – Colormap for edge weights.

  • ax (Axes | None) – Pre-existing axes.

  • show (bool | None) – Display figure.

  • save (str | bool | None) – Save figure.

  • return_fig (bool) – Return Figure instead of Axes.

  • figsize (tuple[float, float]) – Figure size.

  • **kwargs – Passed to nx.draw_networkx.

Return type:

Axes, Figure, or None

deepscenic.pl.network_tf_targets(model, tf, *, top_k=30, threshold=0.0, show_regions=False, ax=None, show=None, save=None, return_fig=False, figsize=(10, 10))[source]#

Plot network of a single TF’s targets.

  • threshold (float) – Minimum weight threshold.

  • ax (Axes | None) – Pre-existing axes.

  • show (bool | None) – Display figure.

  • save (str | bool | None) – Save figure.

  • return_fig (bool) – Return Figure instead of Axes.

  • figsize (tuple[float, float]) – Figure size.

Return type:

Axes, Figure, or None

deepscenic.pl.logo_attribution(attributions, *, sequence=None, start=0, end=None, ax=None, show=None, save=None, return_fig=False, figsize=(12, 3), title=None)[source]#

Plot sequence attribution logo using tangermeme.

Parameters:

  • start (int) – Start position to plot.

  • end (int | None) – End position to plot.

  • ax (Axes | None) – Pre-existing axes.

  • show (bool | None) – Display figure.

  • save (str | bool | None) – Save figure.

  • return_fig (bool) – Return Figure instead of Axes.

  • figsize (tuple[float, float]) – Figure size.

  • title (str | None) – Plot title.

Return type:

Axes, Figure, or None

Raises:

ImportError – If tangermeme is not installed.

Return type:

Axes, Figure, or None

ImportError – If logomaker is not installed.

deepscenic.pl.ism_heatmap(ism_scores, *, start=0, end=None, ax=None, cmap='RdBu_r', center=0, show=None, save=None, return_fig=False, figsize=(14, 3), title=None)[source]#

Plot ISM scores as a heatmap.

  • end (int | None) – End position to plot.

  • ax (Axes | None) – Pre-existing axes.

  • cmap (str) – Colormap (diverging recommended).

  • center (float) – Center value for colormap.

  • show (bool | None) – Display figure.

  • save (str | bool | None) – Save figure.

  • return_fig (bool) – Return Figure instead of Axes.

  • figsize (tuple[float, float]) – Figure size.

  • title (str | None) – Plot title.

Return type:

Axes, Figure, or None

Perturbation Results#

deepscenic.pl.volcano_perturbation(results, *, logfc_col='log2fc', pval_col='pvalue', gene_col='gene', logfc_threshold=0.5, pval_threshold=0.05, top_n_labels=10, highlight_genes=None, ax=None, show=None, save=None, return_fig=False, figsize=(8, 6), title=None)[source]#

Volcano plot of perturbation effects.

Parameters:

  • results (DataFrame) – DataFrame with log2fc, pvalue, and gene columns.

  • logfc_col (str) – Column name for log2 fold change.

  • pval_col (str) – Column name for p-value.

  • gene_col (str) – Column name for gene names.

  • logfc_threshold (float) – Threshold for significant fold change.

  • pval_threshold (float) – Threshold for significant p-value.

  • top_n_labels (int) – Number of top genes to label.

  • highlight_genes (list[str] | None) – Specific genes to highlight.

  • ax (Axes | None) – Pre-existing axes.

  • show (bool | None) – Display figure.

  • save (str | bool | None) – Save figure.

  • return_fig (bool) – Return Figure instead of Axes.

  • figsize (tuple[float, float]) – Figure size.

  • title (str | None) – Plot title.

Return type:

Axes, Figure, or None

Figure or None

deepscenic.pl.dotplot_perturbation(results, *, tfs=None, genes=None, size_col='abs_log2fc', color_col='log2fc', tf_col='tf', gene_col='gene', size_range=(10, 200), cmap='RdBu_r', ax=None, show=None, save=None, return_fig=False, figsize=(12, 8))[source]#

Dot plot of perturbation effects.

Genomics#

deepscenic.pl.genome_browser(mdata=None, *, chrom, start, end, atac_data=None, region_names=None, genes=None, links=None, cell_groups=None, group_colors=None, show_regions=True, show_genes=True, show_links=True, link_cmap='Blues', show=None, save=None, return_fig=False, figsize=None, title=None)[source]#

Multi-track genome browser view.

Parameters:

  • mdata (MuData | None) – MuData object with ATAC data. If provided, extracts data automatically.

  • chrom (str) – Chromosome to display.

  • start (int) – Start position.

  • end (int) – End position.

  • atac_data (ndarray | None) – ATAC accessibility matrix (cells x regions). Alternative to mdata.

  • region_names (list[str] | None) – Region names in format ‘chr:start-end’. Required if atac_data provided.

  • genes (DataFrame | None) – DataFrame with gene annotations (columns: gene, chrom, start, end, strand).

  • links (DataFrame | None) – DataFrame with region-gene links (columns: region, gene, weight).

  • cell_groups (dict[str, ndarray] | None) – Dict mapping group names to cell indices for aggregated tracks.

  • group_colors (dict[str, str] | None) – Dict mapping group names to colors.

  • show_regions (bool) – Show region accessibility track.

  • show_genes (bool) – Show gene annotation track.

  • show_links (bool) – Show region-gene link arcs.

  • link_cmap (str) – Colormap for link arcs.

  • show (bool | None) – Display figure.

  • save (str | bool | None) – Save figure.

  • return_fig (bool) – Return Figure.

  • figsize (tuple[float, float] | None) – Figure size. Auto-calculated if None.

  • title (str | None) – Plot title.

Return type:

Figure or None

deepscenic.pl.arc_plot(links, *, region_col='region', gene_col='gene', weight_col='weight', gene_positions=None, chrom=None, start=None, end=None, cmap='Blues', arc_height=0.5, linewidth=1.0, ax=None, show=None, save=None, return_fig=False, figsize=(12, 4), title=None)[source]#

Plot region-gene links as arcs (Signac-style).

Parameters:

  • links (DataFrame) – DataFrame with region, gene, and weight columns. Region format: ‘chr1:1000-2000’.

  • region_col (str) – Column for region coordinates.

  • gene_col (str) – Column for gene names.

  • weight_col (str) – Column for link weights.

  • gene_positions (dict[str, int] | None) – Optional dict mapping gene names to genomic positions (TSS). If not provided, arcs will be drawn to fixed offset from region.

  • chrom (str | None) – Chromosome to filter.

  • start (int | None) – Start position to filter.

  • end (int | None) – End position to filter.

  • cmap (str) – Colormap for arc colors.

  • arc_height (float) – Height scaling for arcs.

  • linewidth (float) – Arc line width.

  • ax (Axes | None) – Pre-existing axes.

  • show (bool | None) – Display figure.

  • save (str | bool | None) – Save figure.

  • return_fig (bool) – Return Figure.

  • figsize (tuple[float, float]) – Figure size.

  • title (str | None) – Plot title.

Return type:

Axes, Figure, or None
